title: Gen Z Is Really Into Running. Somehow, That’s a Problem Now?
markdown:
gen z loves running—some folks think that's a problem. but here at friday stairs, we say bring it on! whether you're gen z, gen x, or just gen curious, we're all about moving together. every step counts—whether you're chasing a PR or just chasing the sunrise. let's celebrate every stride on the riverwalk. because running isn't about age—it's about energy. and we've got plenty of that to go around. see you at 7am, ready to climb—dj spinning, sun rising, tampa waking up. 🌅🔥

read it: [Runner's World](https://www.runnersworld.com/news/a71548819/gen-z-is-really-into-running-somehow-thats-a-problem-now/)
